title: Form 1099-R box 4 statement items, tax year 2025
closure_claim: Every federal income tax withheld amount reported in box 4 of a Form 1099-R furnished to the taxpayer for tax year 2025 is recorded as a statement item as of the keyed horizon. Independently closed from the box-1 IRA-fully-taxable family (ADR-0016: one family, one authorized subtotal) even though a box-4 member shares its payer/statement/tax-year identity with a box-1 member on the same logical statement. Closed with members authorizes the sum of current members; closed-empty authorizes subtotal 0.
